title: GCP AI Engineer - Agentic AI - Contract - London - Outside
description:
GCP AI Engineer - Agentic AI - Contract - London - Outside

Hybrid - 2-3 Days On-Site per Week


Overview

We're looking for experienced, hands-on GCP AI Engineers to support a major global financial services organisation in designing and developing AI agents across its Finance function.


The organisation is investing in agentic AI capabilities and requires up to four engineers with strong experience designing, building and deploying AI agents using Google's technology stack.


This is a hands-on AI engineering role, focused specifically on delivering production-ready agentic AI solutions rather than traditional software engineering.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and deploy AI agents using Google Cloud's AI technology stack.
  • Build agentic AI solutions to automate complex financial processes, reporting and decision-making.
  • Develop AI agents capable of reasoning, orchestrating workflows, integrating with enterprise systems and executing tasks.
  • Work with Finance stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical AI solutions.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, secure and suitable for enterprise environments.


Priority AI Use Cases

The initial engagement will focus on four key areas:

  • Developing AI agents to monitor regulatory developments, identify relevant changes and provide conversational access to regulatory information.
  • Building agents to automate financial control processes, monitoring and exception identification.
  • Developing AI capabilities to support financial information retrieval, analysis and investor communications.
  • Building agents capable of reviewing underlying financial data, identifying trends and anomalies, and generating meaningful management insights.


Required Experience

  • Minimum 4 years' experience, with a strong focus on designing and developing AI agents.
  • Proven hands-on experience building agentic AI solutions using the Google Cloud technology stack.
  • Strong understanding of AI agent architecture, orchestration, tool calling and multi-step workflows.
  • Experience integrating AI agents with enterprise data, APIs and business systems.
  • Practical experience taking AI agents from initial design through to deployment.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs and their application within enterprise environments.
  • Google Cloud AI certifications are highly desirable.


Desirable Experience

  • Previous experience delivering AI agents within Banking, Financial Services or other regulated environments.
  • Experience developing AI solutions specifically for Finance functions.
  • Familiarity with financial reporting, regulatory compliance, financial controls or management information.


Contract Details


Duration: Initial 3-month contract

Start: Immediate/ASAP

Location: London / Hybrid, 2-3 days on-site per week

Day Rate: up to £600 Outside


We're looking for genuine AI Engineers with a track record of building agents, rather than software engineers who have recently transitioned into AI.


Candidates should have substantial commercial experience delivering agentic AI solutions within Google's ecosystem and be comfortable taking ownership of the design and hands-on development of enterprise AI agents.

RSG Plc is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.
